name: io.github.Imgrund/hybridlog
title: hybridlog
description: Reads your own Garmin mirror: readiness, training load, muscle freshness, and read-only SQL.

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: PostgreSQL URL of the hybridlog database this server reads. The database is created and filled by a hybridlog installation, not by this image.

environmentVariables.name: APP_KEY
environmentVariables.description: APP_KEY of the same hybridlog installation, so the container can read what that installation encrypted.

hybridlog_host.description: Host name of your own hybridlog deployment, for example hybridlog.example.com. There is no shared instance: this server runs on hardware you control.
